settings.heading: The Meridian
settings.text: A single lab-grown diamond on a comfort-fit band of recycled 18k gold. Engraved inside, by hand, with up to eighteen characters of your own.
settings.caption: Meridian, yellow gold, 0.30 ct

settings.quote: Made to be worn every day, and kept for every one after.
settings.text:
The band is 2.4 mm wide and domed inside so it slides on easily and sits close to the finger. The four-claw basket holds the stone low, so it doesn't catch on knitwear.

Each ring is cast in recycled gold, set by hand and engraved inside before it leaves the bench.
settings.caption: Available in white, yellow and rose gold.

settings.text: Insured, signed-for delivery in a gift box

settings.heading: Details & care
settings.text: Questions about sizing or engraving? Our client care team replies the same day.

settings.question: Materials
settings.answer: Recycled 18k gold (750). A 0.30 ct round brilliant lab-grown diamond, F colour, VS1 clarity, with an IGI certificate.

settings.question: Can I return an engraved ring?
settings.answer: Engraved rings are made for you, so they're final sale, but resizing is free within 60 days. Unengraved rings can be returned within 30 days.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Engraving adds three working days. Orders from the drop ship in 7–10 working days, insured and signed for.

settings.question: Caring for your ring
settings.answer: Take it off for the gym and the pool. Clean it with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft brush.
